qualifier: ribonucleotides and ribonucleosides (AMP, IMP, inosine) toward allantoin
name: Purine ribonucleotide and ribonucleoside catabolism
rationale: All members concern degradation of ribo-purines (AMP, IMP, inosine, adenosine/guanosine via ADA and PNP, onward to allantoin), distinguishing the theme from deoxyribonucleotide-metabolism and purine-salvage confusables.

name: Ureteric bud formation and branching
rationale: All three members concern formation of the ureteric bud and regulation of its branching, whereas confusables cover nephric duct, nephron and ureter morphogenesis.

qualifier: combined estrogen and androgen receptor responses
name: Estrogen and androgen receptor signalling
rationale: Members are nuclear sex steroid receptor responses (estrogen, androgen, progesterone, testosterone), and the joint androgen-receptor/prostate arm separates it from estrogen-only confusables while the estrogen arm separates it from the androgen-leaning one.

name: Microtubule organelle transport and microtubule severing
rationale: Members concern microtubule-dependent organelle, mitochondrial and synaptic vesicle transport and organelle sizing, and the microtubule severing/depolymerization members distinguish it from transport-only confusables.

core: Nuclear receptor control of metabolic gene expression
name: LXR, PPARalpha and ROR/REV-ERB metabolic gene regulation
rationale: Members are nuclear-receptor-driven transcription of lipid, glucose and clock genes (LXR, PPARA, ROR/REV-ERB, PGC-1alpha), distinguishing it from SREBP/ChREBP, adipogenesis and BMAL1-output confusables.

name: Fatty acid and eicosanoid oxidation with ichthyosis defects
rationale: Members cover P450 substrate classes (fatty acids, eicosanoids, linoleic acid) plus CYP4F22 and SLC27A4 ichthyoses, separating it from lipoxygenase/hepoxilin and epoxygenase/omega-hydroxylase confusables.

name: Myoblast differentiation and striated muscle regeneration
rationale: Members concern myoblast proliferation, fusion and differentiation and skeletal/cardiac muscle regeneration, distinguishing it from cardiac hypertrophy/calcineurin and muscle atrophy confusables.

name: Positive regulation of respiration with drug and hypoxia responses
rationale: Members combine upregulation of mitochondrial respiration and ATP synthesis with drug, antibiotic, hypoxia and oxidative-stress responses, unlike confusables centred on negative regulation of OXPHOS or anaesthetic responses.

name: Mammary and prostate gland epithelial development
rationale: All members concern mammary or prostate gland epithelial lineage, branching and growth, distinguishing it from lung/salivary branching, reproductive tract and placental confusables.

qualifier: oncogene/oxidative stress-induced, evaded by CDKN2A defects
name: Stress-induced senescence and its evasion via CDKN2A defects
rationale: Members are oncogene- and oxidative-stress-induced senescence, SASP and Polycomb/CDKN2A (p16INK4A, p14ARF) loss, separating it from p53/p21 arrest and SAHF/replicative senescence confusables.

name: Adrenergic control of cardiac contractility and insulin secretion
rationale: Members are adrenoceptor/catecholamine signalling regulating heart rate, contraction force and insulin and catecholamine secretion, distinguishing it from adenylate-cyclase-inhibitory and smooth-muscle confusables.

core: Protein O-fucosylation and O-glucosylation of Notch and TSR proteins
name: Notch and TSR O-glycosylation in somite segmentation
rationale: Members concern O-fucose/O-glucose glycosylation of Notch and TSR domains with LFNG-dependent somitogenesis, separating it from other glycosylation and somite-specification confusables.

name: Hepatic glucose-6-phosphate and fructose metabolism, gluconeogenesis
rationale: Members cover glucokinase, glucose-6-phosphatase/transport disorders, fructose catabolism defects and gluconeogenesis, distinguishing it from glycogen and glycolysis confusables.

qualifier: cytosolic Ca2+ removal via SERCA and Na+/Ca2+ exchange
name: Cardiomyocyte cytosolic calcium removal by SERCA and exchangers
rationale: Members concern lowering cytosolic Ca2+ through sarcoplasmic reticulum uptake and Na+/Ca2+ exchange to control cardiac relaxation and force, while confusables centre on Ca2+ release and ryanodine receptors.

qualifier: renal sodium excretion and urine volume
name: Nitric oxide-cGMP signalling in renal natriuresis and diuresis
rationale: Members are NO/cGMP signalling and its renal effects on glomerular filtration, sodium excretion and blood volume, distinguishing it from endothelial eNOS and vascular tone confusables.

name: Axon guidance via Sema3A and netrin signalling
rationale: Members concern axon guidance and extension through Sema3A-plexin and netrin repulsion, distinguishing it from monoaminergic guidance and collateral sprouting confusables.

name: Two-pore-domain K+ channels in pain and thermosensation
rationale: Members combine K2P channel families with pain, itch and temperature detection and neuronal excitability, separating it from TRP/taste and Ca2+-activated K+ channel confusables.

name: Centriole and basal body control of cilium assembly
rationale: Members concern centriole duplication, cohesion and basal-body anchoring that govern cilium assembly and disassembly, unlike intraflagellar transport and centrosome-positioning confusables.

qualifier: vitamin K gamma-carboxylation and vitamin C
name: Vitamin K-dependent gamma-carboxylation and vitamin C metabolism
rationale: Members cover vitamin K-dependent protein carboxylation and ascorbate/vitamin E metabolism and responses, distinguishing it from redox/BH4 and vitamin K catabolism confusables.

qualifier: elevation via store release and store-operated entry
name: Cytosolic calcium elevation by store release and store-operated entry
rationale: Members concern raising cytosolic Ca2+ by store release, store-operated and voltage-gated entry and Ca2+ sensing, whereas confusables concern Ca2+ removal and ER-mitochondria tethering.

name: TCA cycle, malate-aspartate shuttle and pyruvate metabolism
rationale: Members are TCA cycle intermediates, pyruvate handling and the malate-aspartate shuttle linked to respiration, distinguishing it from PDH/CoA, amino acid and isocitrate/NADPH confusables.

qualifier: centrosome separation via NEK and PLK1
name: Mitotic spindle formation and centrosome separation
rationale: Members concern mitotic spindle assembly and centrosome separation (NEK9/6/7, PLK1, EML4), unlike spindle-checkpoint, cytokinesis and AURKA-regulation confusables.

qualifier: epidermal keratinization and appendages (hair, tooth, nail, glands)
name: Epidermis and ectodermal appendage development
rationale: Members span keratinocyte differentiation, cornification and hair, tooth, nail, sebaceous and placode development, distinguishing it from melanocyte/MITF, gut epithelium and NF-kB ectodermal dysplasia confusables.

name: Cerebellar development and motor coordination behaviour
rationale: Members concern cerebellar layer and cell development with locomotion, righting reflex and motor learning, distinguishing it from brainstem/hindbrain and forebrain development confusables.

qualifier: immediate-early AP-1/NR4A genes and ERK negative feedback
name: Immediate-early AP-1 response and MAPK negative feedback
rationale: Members combine AP-1/NR4A immediate-early gene programmes with ERK inactivation and MAPK feedback, distinguishing it from IL-6/STAT3, ERK activation and phosphatase confusables.
